verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Auth0's Universal Login hosted pages support password/social sign-in and sign-up (auth0-docs-1/22/32/43), with branding/customization via Organizations (auth0-docs-6/24/44), and community corroborates a JS-free hosted login experience (auth0-comm-1). However, the evidence never mentions prebuilt UI component libraries (e.g., Lock widget or framework SDK components) or profile management UI specifically. Missing for 10: explicit prebuilt/customizable UI component documentation, profile management page/component evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of customization depth.
